scope: Known-recording regression comparison after earlier outputs were inspected. These recordings are development evidence, not a new held-out test.
method: Independent atomic-time audit of saved outputs. ASR word-time counts unioned word timestamps inside eligible annotated commercial/protected spans. Continuous-span metrics retain gaps. Unverified ranges are excluded.
limitations: Reference labels and word timestamps are provisional ASR/publisher annotations without human listening verification.
Word-time excludes missing ASR and between-word silence; it does not establish complete acoustic ad removal.
Failed clips remain in eligible denominators and are unscored, not counted as correct or zero-risk.
Pairwise comparisons use identical inputs successfully scored by both runs; this does not erase other failures.
Candidates are proposals; verified suggestions passed two correlated model checks; approved cuts are actual application selections.
Kev has no two-pass verified view and retains mandatory human approval. Confidence scales are not interchangeable.
Frozen source hashes are compared between candidate configuration and saved report, not against a potentially newer checkout.
